### Bug Analysis

#### Bug Scenario Description
The issue arises when trying to use a `Tooltip` component for the `legendText` prop in a `FormGroup`. The current implementation only supports `string` values for `legendText`, which results in a prop type validation error when an object (like a `Tooltip` component) is passed.

#### Bug Root Cause
The root cause is the prop type definition for `legendText` in the `FormGroup` component. It is currently set to only accept `string` values, which prevents the use of React components like `Tooltip`.

### Bug Location
The bug is located in the `FormGroup` component's prop type definition:

```javascript
FormGroup.propTypes = {
  ...
  legendText: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
  ...
};
```

### Patch to Fix the Bug

To fix this issue, we need to update the `legendText` prop type to accept `node` instead of `string`. This will allow any renderable content, including React components, to be used.

```javascript
### packages/react/src/components/FormGroup/FormGroup.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
  /** 
   * Provide the text to be rendered inside of the fieldset <legend>
   */
  legendText: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
=======
  /** 
   * Provide the content to be rendered inside of the fieldset <legend>
   */
  legendText: PropTypes.node.isRequired,
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

This change will allow the `legendText` prop to accept any renderable content, including strings, numbers, and React components, thus resolving the issue.
